request.subject: any news on the background export?
request.body: Still can't pull the full transactions table in one go - it dies partway through. Chopping it into months works but it's a chore every time. Any update on the background/async download thing you mentioned?

rationale: Matches request_tamarind_csv_large (awaiting_work) and work_csv_async_large (open, 'Async manual export for result sets over 1M rows'). attempt_tamarind_split_export (customer-scoped, passed) is the interim workaround the customer already uses and may be reaffirmed. work_csv_async_large depends on work_export_migration, which depends on blocked work_queue_v2_cutover, so the 2026-11-30 forecast is not safe to promise. A new task would duplicate existing work.
